description: Prosumer environment Smart Meter Energy Time Series: Active power measurements with 1s time resolution for one year. is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Ionut Alexandru PUENARU, Radu PLAMANESCU. The dataset includes active power measurements for a residential prosumer located in Mogosoaia, Romania, collected at 1 frame/second reporting rate over 12 consecutive months.Always-on appliances include the refrigerator and the wireless router. Coverage: national (RO); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
